tldr.mechanism: The note announces general meetings about every three months, with Spring and Fall meetings aligned with the Joint Computer Conferences and other meetings moved among sites.

sections.title: A Recurring Meeting Plan
sections.content:
Following the November Houston meeting, general Network Working Group meetings are to be held approximately every three months. The Spring and Fall meetings will coincide with the Joint Computer Conferences.

Other meetings will move among sites to promote exposure to different locations and spread the burden of hosting.
sections.plainLanguage: The group plans regular meetings throughout the year. Moving some meetings to different sites is meant to share the work of hosting.

sections.title: The Next Meeting
sections.content: The next meeting is scheduled for February 17, 18 and 19 at the Illini Union, University of Illinois. Attendees should plan to arrive on the seventeenth and contact Phyllis Ewing by the end of January.
sections.plainLanguage: The notice gives the dates and location for the next meeting. It asks attendees to plan to arrive on the first day and contact the named organizer in advance.

sections.title: More Organized Reports
sections.content:
The announcement says the next meeting will be a bit more organized than previous meetings and will include at least a few prepared reports.

It does not list report topics or describe results, since this document is an announcement.
sections.plainLanguage: The next meeting is expected to include prepared reports. The notice does not say what those reports will cover.
